skill.description: Test local web applications with Playwright by writing scripts, launching managed servers, inspecting rendered pages, capturing screenshots, and collecting console logs.

security_audit.summary: Most Markdown and localhost findings are false positives caused by documentation examples and local-only Playwright usage. The helper script still presents real high-risk behavior because it executes user-supplied server and automation commands, and the skill text discourages source review before use.

remediation.issue: User-supplied server commands are executed through a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid shell=True for server startup, or require explicit review and confirmation for every server command before execution.

remediation.issue: The helper executes arbitrary post-server commands.
remediation.suggestion: Document that only trusted automation commands should be passed after the separator, and validate the command path when possible.

remediation.issue: The instructions discourage source review and promote black-box execution.
remediation.suggestion: Remove language telling agents not to read source, and encourage reviewing helper behavior before running local commands.

remediation.issue: Screenshots and logs may contain sensitive application data.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a project-scoped output directory and warn users before saving diagnostic artifacts from authenticated pages.

content.user_title: Test Local Web Apps with Playwright
content.value_statement: Manual browser checks miss rendered-state issues in local apps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Playwright scripts, screenshots, console logs, and server-assisted testing.
actual_capabilities: Guides synchronous Playwright scripts for local web application testing.
Starts one or more local servers and waits for configured ports.
Captures screenshots, page content, and console messages for debugging.
Discovers buttons, links, and inputs from rendered pages.
Supports static HTML automation through local file URLs.
limitations: It is not a complete test runner or assertion framework.
The helper can run arbitrary local commands, so commands need review.
Examples assume localhost targets and may need selector changes.
It does not assess production security or backend vulnerabilities.

use_cases.title: Validate Local UI Changes
use_cases.description: Check a local frontend after changes by waiting for page readiness and capturing screenshots.

use_cases.title: Debug Browser Behavior
use_cases.description: Collect console messages, rendered DOM details, and visual evidence from a running app.

use_cases.title: Coordinate App Startup
use_cases.description: Start backend and frontend servers before running a browser automation workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Local Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect my local app on port 5173. Wait for network idle, capture a screenshot, and report visible issues.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Page Elements
prompt_templates.scenario: Selector discovery for a rendered page
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the local page, list visible buttons, links, and inputs, then suggest stable selectors for the main workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Console Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a Playwright check that captures console messages while interacting with the dashboard, then summarize errors and likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Run Managed Servers
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the helper usage first. Start the backend and frontend locally, wait for readiness, then verify the login flow with Playwright.

output_examples.input: Inspect my dashboard at localhost and find broken UI controls.
output: Screenshot captured after the page reached network idle.
Found primary navigation, dashboard cards, and three form inputs.
The settings button did not become visible after the expected wait.

output_examples.input: Capture browser console messages during a login attempt.
output: Collected console output during the login workflow.
Found one warning about a missing image asset.
No client-side error blocked form submission.

output_examples.input: Start my local services and verify the checkout page.
output: Both configured ports became ready before testing started.
The checkout page loaded and displayed payment fields.
The submit action failed because a required test value was missing.

best_practices: Review helper usage and commands before starting local servers.
Wait for network idle before inspecting dynamic pages.
Capture screenshots and console logs before changing selectors.
anti_patterns: Running untrusted server commands without review.
Testing dynamic apps before the rendered state is ready.
Saving screenshots or logs that contain secrets to shared locations.

faq.question: Does this skill test deployed production sites?
faq.answer: It is designed for local web applications and static local HTML files. Production testing needs separate approval and safeguards.

faq.question: Which browser automation library does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Python Playwright examples with Chromium in headless mode.

faq.question: Can it start my development server?
faq.answer: Yes, the helper can start local servers and wait for their ports. Review every command before running it.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it choose selectors automatically?
faq.answer: It helps discover rendered buttons, links, and inputs. A reviewer still needs to choose stable selectors for tests.

faq.question: Where are screenshots and logs saved?
faq.answer: Examples save diagnostic files to local output or temporary paths. Use project-scoped paths when files may contain sensitive data.
